text: The appointment of three new members and reappointment of one current member to Toronto Atmospheric Fund's Grants and Programs Committee is recommended.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Appointed the individuals listed in the confidential attachment to the Grants and Programs Committee. 2. Instructed the City Clerk to make the appointees' names public once appointed by the Board, and direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 16, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Atmospheric Fund be kept confidential aa it deals with personal matters about identifiable persons.
